Chassis serial, MAC and every per-transceiver serial are redacted from the committed dump","faceplate-structure":"described by the owner from the unit - top two SFP rows are 2x4 ganged belly-to-belly assemblies, bottom row is 1x2 ganged in the same orientation as row 2. Visible seams measure every 2 columns (~33mm), so the drawn column geometry is unchanged by that grouping; the 2x4 spans two visual pairs. Link/activity arrows sit in the belly-to-belly gap of rows 1-2, three per column (up = row 1, down = row 2, right-hand down = row 3), and the port numbers appear ONCE per column between rows 2 and 3 as N-up / N+1-down / N+2-down - no other SFP row carries numbers","mgmt-block":"owner - the two 10G ports are a 1x2 belly-to-belly gang with arrow LEDs between them and their label below the lower one, USB-A beneath that; the RJ45 pair is top-to-top (latches facing away from each other, not toward) with a USB-C below and the pull-out tab under that stack. The 10G pair is ports 57/58. The SFP-to-QSFP gap is ~21mm, just over one QSFP port width","mgmt-positions":"estimated from IMG_2141 (racked front)","port-arrangement":"3 rows x 16 columns confirmed on the physical unit by the owner. The datasheet panel figure is a marketing render whose column widths do not reconcile - 24 columns would need 342mm and leave no room for the mgmt block","port-count-note":"ArcOS presents swp1-swp56 only. The columns form two groups of two with roughly twice the separation between groups. Above the block each column carries two rows of four lane LEDs (L1-L4), the upper row belonging to the upper port, with the port number at the left of each row - the photo shows this directly","rear-layout":"datasheet figure (PSU2 | 6 fans | PSU1, grounding point each end), geometry reused from the AS7726-32X which shares this chassis width","status-led-labels":"drawing + photo - DIAG, LOC, PS1, PS2 and FAN are printed to the LEFT of their lamps and level with them, not beneath them: the datasheet page-2 System LEDs callout and IMG_2141 agree, and the same layout is visible on the S9510-28DC lamp stack. Right-anchored 1.3mm clear of the lamp column at x 9.2, with each baseline on its lamp centre.
